pain_point: Piano technicians log tuning histories, pitch deviations, string conditions, and repair notes in paper notebooks with no fast mobile-friendly way to recall what a specific piano needed last visit
target_user: Registered Piano Technicians (RPTs) and independent piano tuners
visual_style: Player Piano Roll — warm cream scroll paper background, perforated edge details, black note-head accents, mechanical precision typography inspired by player piano rolls and vintage musical instrument engineering
tech_stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, served via nginx in Docker
